data.gender_notes: Shaambhavya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shaambhavya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shaam', which means 'prosperity', and 'Bhavya', which means 'goddess'. This name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the embodiment of prosperity and wealth in Hindu mythology. It is believed that invoking the blessings of Shaambhavya can bring prosperity, success, and good fortune in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the abundance of divine grace and blessings. It is believed that the goddess Shaambhavya bestows her blessings upon those who call upon her, bringing prosperity, success, and good fortune in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Shaambhavya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shaambhavya total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
